## What lands

- **The SIG-GOV-017 analysis, written first** —
  `docs/build/reports/p37.72-gov017-analysis/PACKET.md`. It tests the bounded
  control against all four GOV-017 prohibitions (real-time liveness feed /
  per-person lookup / "is a camera watching me right now" surface /
  officer tracking) and finds **compliance**: SIG never receives the
  position, the release data can express no "right now", the In-view
  list/count is a viewport function identical to a manual pan or a typed
  coordinate jump, and the marginal capability over what a viewer can
  already do is zero. The residual GOV-019 tension is named honestly, and
  the verdict records the compliance contract the build pins — any future
  marker, proximity label/list/count, distance-to-viewer, persistence or
  send returns to a fresh analysis and the operator. No pause was needed.
- **The control** — a "My location" button in the `/map/` chrome beside the
  pan pad (K1 §4.1). One-shot `navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition` on
  the explicit click only (spy-proven: 0 reads on load/hydration);
  `enableHighAccuracy: false`, 300 s `maximumAge`, 10 s timeout; never
  `watchPosition`. It `easeTo`s to `myLocationTarget` (centre + a zoom floor
  at the site band — never a zoom-out); the existing moveend path writes
  the same zoom-rounded `at=` every pan writes (`sig.workspace-state`
  unchanged — a transient action, not new URL state).
- **The pins** — no marker is drawn at the position; no 'cameras near you'
  list/count/alert/proximity copy exists (asserted page-wide); denial /
  timeout / unavailable each show honest "map stays where it is" copy and
  never rewrite the viewport; `Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(self)` on
  `/map/` was already wired (P36.19/ADR-156) — cited, not re-decided.
- **Tests** — unit: `myLocationTarget` shape + floor; `geoFailureNote`
  proximity-free. e2e `map-mylocation.spec.ts` (4): click-only read spy;
  pan + settled `at=`; **every request the click produces is asserted free
  of the position**; no markers; no proximity copy; honest denial; axe
  WCAG 2.2 AA on the controls row.
